title: Local emergency declaration
description: Declaration (proclamation) of a local emergency signed by a mayor, county executive or board chair: WHEREAS clauses stating the facts, a NOW, THEREFORE operative paragraph, the numbered emergency powers invoked (procurement, curfew, mutual aid, price gouging, evacuation), duration and council ratification, signature and the clerk's attestation under a municipal seal. Statutory authority is a plausible local placeholder (for example a chapter of the county code), not a real state statute number.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction declaring the emergency (defaults to the project's organization)

office.description: Issuing office shown above the title

whereas.description: WHEREAS clauses, one fact each, without the leading 'WHEREAS,' (2-6)

examples: on October 22, 2026, a cyberattack disabled the computer-aided dispatch system serving the Lakeshore County 911 Center; and

declaration.description: Operative paragraph, the text that follows 'NOW, THEREFORE,'
examples: I, Dana Whitfield, County Executive of Lakeshore County, do hereby declare that a local state of emergency exists throughout Lakeshore County.

powers.description: Emergency powers and orders invoked, one per item (up to 6)

examples: The Director of Emergency Management is authorized to activate the Emergency Operations Center and request mutual aid.

authority.description: Legal authority cited (a local code chapter or generic state law reference)
examples: Chapter 12 (Emergency Management) of the Lakeshore County Code
seven (7) days from signing, at 6:45 p.m. on October 29, 2026

ratification.description: Ratification or extension by the legislative body
examples: This declaration shall be presented to the County Council for ratification at its next regular or special meeting and may be extended only by Council resolution.

name.description: Name (also shown as a handwritten signature)
Name (also shown as a handwritten signature)

marking.description: Exercise marking printed above and below the document
